question: Who became the youngest player ever to win a WTA 1000 title on 22 February 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mirra Andreeva**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On **22 February 2025**, **Mirra Andreeva** became the youngest player in history to win a **WTA 1000** title.
 
• The record-breaking victory occurred at the **Dubai Duty Free Tennis Championships**, which is a prestigious **hard-court** tournament held in the **United Arab Emirates**.
 
• At the time of her triumph, **Mirra Andreeva** was approximately **17 years and 300 days old**, surpassing the previous benchmarks set by other teenage stars in the **WTA 1000** category.
 
• This victory marked her **first career WTA 1000 title**, propelling her into the **Top 10** of the **WTA Rankings** for the first time in her career.
 
• Her run to the title involved defeating several established **Grand Slam** champions and top-seeded players, solidifying her reputation as a generational talent in professional tennis.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **WTA 1000 Tournaments:** 
 
 
• These represent the highest tier of women's professional tennis events organized by the **Women's Tennis Association (WTA)**, second only to the **Grand Slams** and the **WTA Finals**.
 
• Winners of these events are awarded **1000 ranking points**. Prominent **WTA 1000** venues include **Indian Wells**, **Miami**, **Madrid**, **Rome**, **Beijing**, and **Dubai**.
 
 
 
• **Mirra Andreeva:** 
 
 
• Born on **29 April 2007** in **Krasnoyarsk, Russia**, she made a rapid ascent through the professional ranks.
 
• She gained global attention in **2023** after reaching the fourth round of **Wimbledon** at just **16 years old**.
 
• Her elder sister, **Erika Andreeva**, is also a professional tennis player on the **WTA Tour**.
 
 
 
• **Comparison with Other Players:**
 
 
• **Coco Gauff** (Option 4) previously held records as one of the youngest **WTA 1000** winners when she won the **Cincinnati Open** in **2023** at the age of **19**.
 
• **Iga Świątek** (Option 1) is a dominant force in women's tennis who won her first **Grand Slam** (French Open) at age **19** in **2020** and became the **World No. 1** in **2022**.
 
• **Clara Tauson** (Option 2) is another young talent from **Denmark** known for her powerful baseline game, though she has not yet reached the record-breaking milestones achieved by **Andreeva** in the **WTA 1000** circuit as of early **2025**.
 
 
 
• **Dubai Duty Free Tennis Championships:**
 
 
• This event is a major stop on the tennis calendar and features both **ATP** and **WTA** draws.
 
• The tournament is known for its high prize money and state-of-the-art facilities at the **Aviation Club Tennis Centre**.
